_comment: Was TRANSFORM_HERO, which is Arakni's 'become a random Agent of Chaos' -- a real type doing something else entirely, so this called become_agent_of_chaos on an Illusionist hero. The unread 'from'/'to' keys were the only visible symptom. Transform (CR 8.5.36) puts the transformed object UNDER the new permanent; it is not a swap or a destroy. Go again is printed on the card, so it belongs to the same play, not a second ability.
